case.name: O'Flaherty & Ors v Permanent TSB Public Ltd Company & Ors [2026] IEHC 74

relevance: The judgment records a pleaded dispute that the Land Registry map was incorrect.
The judgment discusses Folio boundaries, a severed folio and an alleged landlocked retained part.
The court declined to resolve the boundary issue on the material before it, illustrating that a folio/map question can require additional factual and legal evidence.
verified_limit: The case must not be used to state a universal rule about boundary conclusiveness. It demonstrates the need for separate factual/legal analysis where map, folio and physical land do not align.
system_effect: A title-plan result cannot automatically be presented as a definitive physical-boundary determination.
Boundary disputes require a separate evidence path.
Where map, folio, deeds, occupation and physical features conflict, the answer must expose the conflict rather than silently choose one source.
remaining: Additional primary authorities specifically interpreting sections 84-88.
Full historical case-law network for boundary and registry-map disputes.
